title: Mirrors don't flip left and right

scenes.text: Mirrors don't flip left and right.
Raise your right hand, and your reflection raises the hand on the same side.
Your head stays up, your feet stay down. Nothing swaps sideways.
What a mirror actually flips is front and back.
Your nose points at the mirror. Your reflection's nose points back at you.
Your brain just imagines walking around to stand where the reflection is.
